title: Clever Sea Otters Use Rocks as Tools!
title_zh: 聰明的海獺會用石頭當工具！

paragraphs.en: Scientists in California discovered something amazing about sea otters. These cute marine animals use small rocks as tools to open hard shells!
paragraphs.zh: 加州的科學家發現了關於海獺的驚人祕密。這些可愛的海洋動物會把小石頭當作工具，用來敲開堅硬的貝殼！

paragraphs.en: By using rocks, sea otters can eat bigger crabs and snails without hurting their teeth. Some otters even keep their favorite rock in a special pocket under their arm!
paragraphs.zh: 藉由使用石頭，海獺可以吃到更大的螃蟹和海螺，而且不會弄傷牙齒。有些海獺甚至會把最心愛的石頭收在腋下的專屬小口袋裡呢！

scientists.explanation: 專門觀察大自然、做實驗來解開世界謎團的人。
scientists.example: The scientist studies ocean animals every day.

discovered.explanation: 找到以前沒人知道的新事物或祕密。
discovered.example: They discovered a secret cave on the island.

amazing.explanation: 讓人忍不住睜大眼睛說「哇！」的事情。
amazing.example: Dolphins can jump very high. It is amazing!

marine.explanation: 跟大海有關的，或是住在海裡面的。
marine.example: Whales and sea turtles are marine animals.

shells.explanation: 保護螃蟹、蝸牛或貝類身體的堅硬外殼。
shells.example: We found pretty shells on the beach.

favorite.explanation: 在所有東西裡面，你第一名喜歡的那一個。

pocket.explanation: 衣服上（或動物皮膚皺摺裡）用來裝小東西的小袋子。
pocket.example: He put a shiny coin in his pocket.

quiz.question: 1. What is the main idea of this news story?
options: Sea otters love to swim in cold water.
Sea otters smartly use rocks to help them eat.
Scientists in California are looking for crabs.
Crabs and snails have very sharp teeth.
quiz.explanation: 整篇新聞主要在介紹海獺非常聰明，會利用石頭敲開硬殼來吃東西並保護牙齒喔！

quiz.question: 2. Why do sea otters use rocks to open hard shells?
options: So they will not hurt their teeth.
Because they want to build a stone house.
quiz.explanation: 第二段提到 'without hurting their teeth'，用石頭敲開硬殼才不會咬壞自己的牙齒！

quiz.question: 3. Where does a sea otter keep its favorite rock?
options: In a special pocket under its arm
quiz.explanation: 文章最後一句提到，海獺腋下有鬆鬆的皮膚皺摺，就像專屬小口袋（pocket under their arm）一樣可以收石頭！

quiz.question: 4. Look at the word 'marine' in Paragraph 1. Which animal is also a 'marine' animal?
quiz.explanation: 'marine' 是「海洋的」意思，選項中只有住在海裡的海豚（dolphin）是海洋動物喔！
